p: chariots out from between: By chariots here, as by horses before, he means the swift messengers of God to execute and declare his will.

two mountains: By the mountains he means the external counsel and providence of God, by which he has from before all eternity declared what will come to pass, and that which neither Satan nor all the world can alter.
red horses: Which signifies the great cruelty and persecution that the Church had endured under different enemies.
black horses: Signifying that they had endured great afflictions under the Babylonians.
white horses: These represented their state under the Persians, who restored them to their liberty.

spotted and bay horses: Which signified that God would sometimes give his Church rest, and pour his plagues upon their enemies, as he did in destroying Nineveh and Babylon, and other of their enemies.
spirits of the heavens: Meaning, all the actions and motions of God's Spirit, whom according to his unchangeable counsel he causes to appear through all the world.
south country: That is, towards Egypt, and other countries there about.
bay went forth: That is, those of different colours, which ask permission, to signify that Satan has no power to hurt or afflict, until God gives it to him; Job 1:12.
spirit in the north country: By punishing the Chaldeans my anger ceased, and you were delivered.

Josiah the son of Zephaniah: To receive from him and the other three, money to make the two crowns: who were men of great authority among the Jews, and doubted of the restitution of the kingdom, and of the priesthood, and hurt others by their example.
head of Joshua the son of: Because this could not be attributed to any one according to the Law, therefore it follows that Joshua must represent the Messiah, who was both Priest and King.
BRANCH: Meaning Christ, of whom Joshua was the figure: for in Greek they were both called Jesus.
up out of his place: That is, of himself without the help of man.
build the temple of the LORD: Which declares that no one could build this temple of which Haggai speaks, but only Christ: and therefore it was spiritual, and not material; Ha 2:9.
glory: Of which Joshua had but a shadow.
them both: The two offices of the kingdom and priesthood, will be joined together in such a way, that they will no longer be separated.
Helem: Who was also called Heldai.
Hen the son of Zephaniah: He was also called Joshias.

memorial in the temple of the: That they may acknowledge their infirmity, who thought that all things would be restored immediately: and of this their infidelity these two crowns will remain as tokens; Ac 1:6.
far off shall come and build: That is, the Gentiles by the preaching of the Gospel, will help toward the building of the spiritual temple.
obey the voice of the LORD: If you will believe and remain in the obedience of faith.
